groups.name: iqkv.db
groups.description: Intermediary database connection properties. Values are composed into spring.datasource by profile ymls.

groups.name: iqkv.rabbitmq
groups.description: Intermediary RabbitMQ connection properties. Values are composed into spring.rabbitmq by profile ymls.

groups.name: iqkv.redis
groups.description: Intermediary Redis connection properties. Values are composed into spring.data.redis by profile ymls.

groups.name: iqkv.mail
groups.description: Intermediary mail connection properties. Values are composed into spring.mail and iqkv.notification.mail.

groups.name: iqkv.platform
groups.description: Platform-wide operational settings. Must be consistent across all core services (IAM, Billing, Gateway).

groups.name: iqkv.billing
groups.description: Billing service integration properties consumed by the entitlement plan resolver.

groups.name: iqkv.objectstorage
groups.description: S3-compatible object storage configuration. Supports MinIO (SIT/UAT) and AWS S3 (production).

groups.name: iqkv.objectstorage.upload
groups.description: Upload policy constraints applied before an object is sent to storage.

properties.name: iqkv.db.host
properties.description: Database server hostname.

properties.name: iqkv.db.port
properties.description: Database server port.

properties.name: iqkv.db.name
properties.description: Database name.

properties.name: iqkv.db.username
properties.description: Database username.

properties.name: iqkv.db.password
properties.description: Database password.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.host
properties.description: RabbitMQ broker hostname.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.port
properties.description: RabbitMQ broker AMQP port.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.username
properties.description: RabbitMQ username.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.password
properties.description: RabbitMQ password.

properties.name: iqkv.redis.host
properties.description: Redis server hostname.

properties.name: iqkv.redis.port
properties.description: Redis server port.

properties.name: iqkv.redis.password
properties.description: Redis authentication password. Empty when the server has no auth.

properties.name: iqkv.redis.database
properties.description: Redis logical database index.

properties.name: iqkv.redis.timeout
properties.description: Redis command timeout.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.host
properties.description: SMTP server hostname.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.port
properties.description: SMTP server port.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.username
properties.description: SMTP authentication username.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.password
properties.description: SMTP authentication password.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.from
properties.description: Default From address for outgoing emails.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.from-name
properties.description: Display name for the From address in outgoing emails.

properties.name: iqkv.mail.reply-to
properties.description: Default Reply-To address for outgoing emails.

properties.name: iqkv.platform.rollout-mode
properties.description: Platform-wide operational mode. Must match across all core services. MULTI_TENANT: each signup creates a new tenant with TENANT_OWNER authority. SINGLE_TENANT: all users join a single pre-provisioned tenant with MEMBER authority.

properties.name: iqkv.billing.service-url
properties.description: Base URL of the billing service used by the entitlement plan resolver for quota enforcement.

properties.name: iqkv.billing.plan-refresh-interval
properties.description: How often the entitlement plan catalog cache is refreshed from the billing service.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.jwt.private-key-path
properties.description: Path to the RSA private key PEM file used for signing JWTs. Supports classpath: and file: prefixes.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.jwt.public-key-path
properties.description: Path to the RSA public key PEM file used for verifying JWTs. Supports classpath: and file: prefixes.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.jwt.expiry
properties.description: Access token lifetime.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.jwt.refresh-expiry
properties.description: Refresh token lifetime.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.jwt.issuer
properties.description: JWT iss claim value.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.security.password-encoder-strength
properties.description: BCrypt encoder strength (cost factor). Must be >= 4.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.security.min-length
properties.description: Minimum password length.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.security.rate-limiting.login-attempts
properties.description: Maximum failed login attempts before account lockout.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.security.rate-limiting.lockout-duration
properties.description: Duration of account lockout after exceeding failed login attempts.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.password-reset.token-ttl
properties.description: Password reset token time-to-live.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.password-reset.rate-limit-window
properties.description: Sliding window for password reset rate limiting.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.password-reset.rate-limit-max-requests
properties.description: Maximum password reset requests allowed within the rate limit window.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.magic-link.enabled
properties.description: Enables passwordless magic-link authentication.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.magic-link.token-ttl
properties.description: Magic-link token time-to-live.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.magic-link.rate-limit-window
properties.description: Sliding window for magic-link request rate limiting.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.magic-link.rate-limit-max-requests
properties.description: Maximum magic-link requests allowed within the rate limit window.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.enabled-providers
properties.description: Comma-separated list of enabled OAuth2 provider ids (google, github, microsoft).

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.base-url
properties.description: Public base URL of this service, used to build OAuth2 callback redirect URIs.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.post-login-redirect-uri
properties.description: Frontend URL the user is redirected to after a successful OAuth2 login.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.auto-provision-users
properties.description: Whether users authenticating via OAuth2 are auto-provisioned when no local account exists.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.encryption-key
properties.description: Symmetric key used to encrypt sensitive OIDC/OAuth2 state. Required in non-dev environments.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.state-ttl
properties.description: OAuth2 authorization-state time-to-live. Must not exceed state-ttl-max.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.state-ttl-max
properties.description: Upper bound for the OAuth2 authorization-state time-to-live.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.google.client-id
properties.description: Google OAuth2 client id.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.google.client-secret
properties.description: Google OAuth2 client secret.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.google.scopes
properties.description: Comma-separated OAuth2 scopes requested from Google.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.google.redirect-uri
properties.description: Google OAuth2 redirect URI template. Supports {baseUrl} and {registrationId} placeholders.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.github.client-id
properties.description: GitHub OAuth2 client id.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.github.client-secret
properties.description: GitHub OAuth2 client secret.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.github.scopes
properties.description: Comma-separated OAuth2 scopes requested from GitHub.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.github.redirect-uri
properties.description: GitHub OAuth2 redirect URI template. Supports {baseUrl} and {registrationId} placeholders.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.microsoft.client-id
properties.description: Microsoft OAuth2 client id.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.microsoft.client-secret
properties.description: Microsoft OAuth2 client secret.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.microsoft.scopes
properties.description: Comma-separated OAuth2 scopes requested from Microsoft.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.microsoft.redirect-uri
properties.description: Microsoft OAuth2 redirect URI template. Supports {baseUrl} and {registrationId} placeholders.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.microsoft.provider
properties.description: Spring Security provider id bound for the Microsoft registration.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.providers.microsoft.issuer-uri
properties.description: Microsoft OIDC issuer URI. The tenant id defaults to 'common' when not overridden.

properties.name: iqkv.auth.oauth2.auto-link.enabled
properties.description: Whether an OAuth2 login is automatically linked to an existing local account with the same verified email.

properties.name: iqkv.invitation.token-ttl
properties.description: How long an invitation token remains valid.

properties.name: iqkv.invitation.reaper-interval
properties.description: How often the InvitationReaperJob runs to expire stale PENDING invitations. Used directly in @Scheduled(fixedDelayString).

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.default-tenant-key
properties.description: NanoID key of the default tenant used in SINGLE tenancy mode. Must be exactly 8 lowercase alphanumeric characters [a-z0-9]. Auto-generated if blank.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.default-tenant-name
properties.description: Display name for the default tenant in SINGLE tenancy mode.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.schema-prefix
properties.description: PostgreSQL schema name prefix for tenant schemas.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.default-schema
properties.description: Default (system) schema name.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.provisioning-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time allowed for tenant schema provisioning before it is considered stuck.

properties.name: iqkv.messaging.rabbitmq.enabled
properties.description: Enables RabbitMQ messaging. When false, all AMQP beans are skipped.

properties.name: iqkv.notification.mail.from
properties.description: From address used in outgoing notification emails.

properties.name: iqkv.notification.mail.from-name
properties.description: Display name for the From address in outgoing notification emails.

properties.name: iqkv.notification.mail.reply-to
properties.description: Reply-To address used in outgoing notification emails.

properties.name: iqkv.notification.mail.provider
properties.description: Active email transport provider: 'smtp' or 'resend'.

properties.name: iqkv.notification.mail.resend.api-key
properties.description: Resend API key. Required when iqkv.notification.mail.provider=resend.

properties.name: iqkv.notification.default-locale
properties.description: Default locale for notification templates.

properties.name: iqkv.notification.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the frontend application, used in email links.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.tenant-runner-enabled
properties.description: Registers the TenantLiquibaseRunner so pending changesets are applied to every tenant schema on startup.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.system-change-log
properties.description: Classpath location of the system (public schema) Liquibase changelog.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.tenant-change-log
properties.description: Classpath location of the per-tenant schema Liquibase changelog.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.contexts
properties.description: Active Liquibase contexts (e.g. demo to include seed data, or omit for clean schema only).

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.bootstrap-tenants
properties.description: Tenant keys whose schemas are migrated during bootstrap, in addition to the system schema.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.upgrade-existing-tenants
properties.description: Whether the TenantLiquibaseRunner scans and upgrades already-provisioned tenant schemas on startup.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.endpoint
properties.description: S3-compatible endpoint URL. Use the MinIO in-cluster service URL for SIT/UAT, or https://s3.amazonaws.com for AWS S3 in production.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.public-endpoint
properties.description: Publicly reachable object storage URL used to rewrite presigned URLs before returning them to external clients. When blank, presigned URLs are returned unchanged.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.access-key
properties.description: S3 / MinIO access key (username). Injected from a Kubernetes Secret in cluster environments.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.secret-key
properties.description: S3 / MinIO secret key (password). Injected from a Kubernetes Secret in cluster environments.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.bucket-name
properties.description: Name of the S3 bucket used to store IAM assets (e.g. user avatars).

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.region
properties.description: AWS region identifier. Required by the S3 client even when connecting to MinIO.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.ssl
properties.description: Whether to use HTTPS when connecting to the object storage endpoint. Must be true in production.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.upload.max-file-size-bytes
properties.description: Maximum allowed upload file size in bytes. Requests exceeding this limit are rejected before reaching storage.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.upload.presigned-url-expiration-minutes
properties.description: Lifetime of a pre-signed PUT or GET URL in minutes.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.upload.allowed-mime-types
properties.description: Comma-separated list of accepted MIME types. Uploads with a Content-Type not in this list are rejected.
